page_title: AUX 1-2 MON | Auxerre v Monaco 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Romain Lissorgue is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Caio Henrique (Monaco) is awarded a yellow card.
90+2' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Takumi Minamino and he is replaced by Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a substitution. Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) is replacing Kevin Danois.
89' 1 - 2 It's a goal! George Ilenikhena (Monaco) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Vanderson and scores magnificently from close range into the top right corner. 1:2.
86' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' The Monaco players are stunned as referee Romain Lissorgue changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
82' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Monaco using VAR. Let's see what happens.
81' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) commits a rough foul. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and makes a call. Monaco are awarded a penalty kick!
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mika Biereth walks off the pitch to be replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
78' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Lamine Camara (Monaco) replaces Aladji Bamba.
77' Lassine Sinayoko goes off the pitch and Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) comes on.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
75' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Paris Brunner (Monaco).
73' The corner is swung in but Auxerre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
73' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) puts the ball into his own net.
72' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Aladji Bamba (Monaco) is given a yellow card.
70' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
68' It's the second caution for Josue Casimir (Auxerre) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Romain Lissorgue.
68' The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
65' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) replacing Sekou Mara.
64' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) gets booked.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Paris Brunner (Monaco) comes onto the pitch so that Folarin Balogun can be given a rest.
63' Here is a change. Kassoum Ouattara is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Caio Henrique (Monaco).
62' Monaco take a short corner kick.
60' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.

55' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is punished with the yellow card.
55' The ratio of the ball possession is 26:74.
50' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
49' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
47' Monaco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
41' The Monaco players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
40' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:4.
38' The yellow card is received by Denis Zakaria (Monaco).
37' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
35' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Auxerre comes to nothing.
33' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
33' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Auxerre.
30' 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
29' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
26' Vanderson (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Theo De Percin, who smothers the ball.
25' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
22' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

21' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Philipp Kohn, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Auxerre.
21' The Auxerre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' 1:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
19' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
16' Neat passing move from Monaco in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' It could have been a good chance to score! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) fails to release Kassoum Ouattara with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.

12' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
10' The percentage of ball possession is – 15:85.
9' Great teamplay by Monaco as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' Mika Biereth (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.

6' What a chance that is! Sekou Mara (Auxerre) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
3' Monaco enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
